content.rendered:
Parent Login Information

Parents of Sherwood High School students may access several online information systems.

For questions regarding login credentials or to obtain a login for a particular system, please contact the main office at (503) 825-6000.

  • Canvas  – Course material, syllabus, daily class agenda (Grades 6-12).
  • ParentVUE -View grades, attendance, schedules (grades 6-12); pay fees (grades PK-12).
